title: Author parameter.yml for fabric-cicd environment-specific configuration
description: Write the fabric-cicd parameter.yml that maps environment-specific values — lakehouse IDs, workspace IDs, connection GUIDs — so the same artifact definitions deploy across environments without hand-editing. Independent of the Service Principal, so it can proceed in parallel with task-043.
acceptanceCriteria: fabric/parameter.yml exists and validates against the fabric-cicd parameter schema.
Every hardcoded workspace/lakehouse GUID currently embedded in the notebook and pipeline definitions is represented as a parameterised value — the audit of which GUIDs those are is part of this task.
The HttpServer connection IDs used by the bronze copy activities are parameterised (they are environment-bound).
No credentials or secrets appear in the file.
A short comment block at the top states which values must change per environment and where they come from.
notes: CREATED 2026-07-29 by /work task-spec coherence audit. Spec § Next Steps & Priorities defines Phase 4 (CI/CD Deployment) with concrete deliverables, but the project had zero Phase 4 tasks — verified by a grep probe with a positive control. This task is part of the 4-task set that closes that coverage gap.
Spec anchor: § Next Steps & Priorities → Phase 4 deliverable 1, 'parameter.yml for environment-specific configuration (lakehouse IDs, connection strings)'.

PRIOR ART: memory records that Fabric dataflow connection bindings live outside the git definition and a workspace update from git silently unbinds every dataflow. Parameterising connection IDs does not fix that — call the re-bind step out explicitly so a CI deploy does not appear to succeed while leaving dataflows dead.
